messages:
maya: Heads-up — I opened a small PR to consolidate streaming+429 fallback examples across SDKs. The goal: one canonical pattern for resume-on-interrupt + exponential-backoff. PTAL: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pulls/4827 :eyes:
jordan: Nice — can you summarize what the canonical behavior will be? e.g., client retries vs server fallback, and whether we recommend resumable streaming or full-request retry?
maya: Summary in the PR description but TL;DR: prefer resumable streaming where possible (stream token checkpointing + partial-acceptance fallback). If streaming can't resume, show a safe full-request retry pattern with idempotency-key and Retry-After handling.
sam: We need snippets for node/python/ruby. Can we keep them minimal — 6–10 lines each? Also we should add a compact table of Retry-After precedence and when to backoff vs escalate.
maya: Agreed. I sketched node + python in the PR. Ruby would be great — @sam, want to add? If not I'll stub and mark for follow-up.
eli: QA ask: are we verifying examples under our integration test harness? We catch drift when SDK surfaces change. We should add a smoke test that simulates a 429 mid-stream and asserts resume path is exercised.
maya: Good call. I'll add a tiny mocha/pytest smoke that mocks a partial stream close and then checks the client uses last-ack token to resume. Test will live under docs/snippets/tests/stream-resume.
jordan: For the docs prose, call out risks: increased cost if clients retry aggressively, race conditions for duplicate side-effects — show idempotency pattern with header X-Idempotency-Key. Also link to the error-ref 429/timeouts page.
maya: Will do. Also fixed a couple of dead links in the errref anchor list while I was there. docs-bot: PR 4827 pushed to staging docs site: https://docs.redwood.ai/preview/4827 — preview builds include snippet rendering for node/python, needs ruby.
sam: Pushed ruby snippet to the branch — tiny example:
```ruby
# resume token + backoff
client.stream(resume_token: token) do |chunk|
  # process
end
# on 429 -> sleep jittered backoff, then client.resume(token)
```
eli: Nice & concise. For the smoke test, can we also assert that when server returns Retry-After the client respects it? That was a regression last quarter.
maya: Yes — test will include a Retry-After header path. I'll also add a short decision box in the docs: when Retry-After > 10s recommend circuit-breaker escalation.
jordan: One more ops item: ensure the SDKs expose a standardized error type with .retry_after and .retryable flags so snippets can be copy/pasted. Open an SDK issue and link it from the PR.
maya: Filed SDK-issue #992 and linked in the PR description. I also added a short migration note for teams using the old implicit retries.
docs-bot: Reminder: please add the changelog blurb under docs/CHANGELOG.md; release cut for next sprint if merged.
maya: I'll add the changelog and assign reviewers @jordan + @sam. ETA today for updates, will request final review after tests are green. :rocket:
